fields.description: Avenue Park Towers II brings apartments and duplexes to Wasl 1 in Al Kifaf, beside Zabeel Park. Tower A has one- and two-bedroom homes; Tower B adds maid’s rooms and larger duplex layouts, with separate rooftop facilities.

reviewCoverage.identity: Exact protected Avenue Park Towers II, not original Avenue Park Towers. Own project page and public broker kit retrieved 200 ordinary GET, no registration submitted. Current page now has full mix and 40/60, unlike stale early-announcement secondary pages.
reviewCoverage.location: Own page explicitly Wasl 1 in Al Kifaf beside Zabeel Park, Dubai Metro walking distance. No guessed coordinates or journey guarantees; exact central dubai-al-kifaf registry.

Actual 3BR duplex lower 34 note pool ONLY 2305/2505/2705, not all six. 4BR lower 36 shows bedroom 4/pool/lift, upper 37 completes family. No room furnishing/appliance entitlements invented.
reviewCoverage.pricing: No own current price list found in public kit (brochure/facts/floorplates/unitplans). Remington 1.9m attributed secondary entry, price NULL, no selected resale quote used as project price. Early GRAF no-price summary stale.

Remington 10 booking +six 5 +60 ends 30 June 2030 corroborates 40/60 only; exact dates not adopted as contractual. Older GRAF 60/40 DLD-derived unconfirmed contradictory not preferred over current own.
reviewCoverage.handover: Own original facts 2 and brochure 55 explicit Q2 2030 developer target. Secondary DLD-derived pages March 2030 conflict with own current phase pack, not actual completion proof. No progress percentage invented.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own public /en/avenue-park-towers2/brokers-kit links 57p brochure, 3p facts, 14p floorplates, 38p unitplans all 200; actual numeric and facts panels saved and viewed. research.locationNote: Wasl 1, Al Kifaf, adjacent to Zabeel Park and within walking distance of the Metro.
overview: The factsheet identifies 541 planned homes: 405 in Tower A and 136 in Tower B. These are design counts, not current inventory.

research.paymentNote: Wasl publishes 40% during construction and 60% on handover. A signed unit calendar was not retrieved; broker instalment dates remain unconfirmed.

unresolved: Factsheet ranges differ from the unit pack: 1BR maximum 1,507 versus 1,503.72 ft²; 2BR 3,215 versus 3,256.19; 3BR 2,123 versus 2,118.55. Confirm approved drawings.
Plan 4 prints 1,503.72 ft² although 797.39+708.27=1,505.66. Plan 7 has a malformed 79739.40 ft² suite figure. Other component totals differ by 0.01 ft². Duplex totals cover both levels.
The 3BR duplex pool applies only to units 2305, 2505 and 2705. Do not assume every duplex has a pool.
Current stock, official prices, service charges, allocated parking and binding payment dates remain unverified.
